title: "Maaslin_Prev_overlap"
output: html_document
date: "2026-05-09"
---

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("tidyverse"))
```


#1) Read in the 16S data
```{r}
maaslin <- read_tsv("all_results_maaslin2_16s.tsv")
metadata <- read_csv('metadata_IFGvSBC.csv')

prev.16 <- read_csv('16s_prevalent_taxa.csv')
taxonomy.16 <- read_tsv('taxonomy_16S.tsv') %>%
  mutate(Taxa = paste(Domain, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species, sep = '; ')) %>%
  select(ASV_ID, Taxa)
```

#2) Plot the 16s
```{r}
#Set up data for plotting
rVs <- maaslin %>%
  mutate(feature = gsub("^X", "", feature)) %>% #Maaslin adds 'X' in front of IDs starting with numbers, removing those to match with taxonomy
  left_join(taxonomy.16, by = c("feature" = "ASV_ID")) %>%
  mutate(enrich = ifelse(qval > 0.2, "NO",
                  ifelse(coef > 0, "IFG",
                  ifelse(coef < 0, "SBC", NA))))

prev.16.IFG <- prev.16 %>%
  filter(Substrate == "IFG_Unique") %>%
  pull(ASV_ID)

prev.16.SBC <- prev.16 %>%
  filter(Substrate == "SBC_Unique") %>%
  pull(ASV_ID)

top.enrich.overlap.IFG.16 <- rVs %>%
  slice_min(qval, n = 20) %>%
  filter(feature %in% prev.16.IFG)

top.enrich.overlap.SBC.16 <- rVs %>%
  slice_min(qval, n = 20) %>%
  filter(feature %in% prev.16.SBC)
``` 

#export overlap table for 16S
```{r}
overlap_table.16 <- rbind(top.enrich.overlap.IFG.16, top.enrich.overlap.SBC.16) %>%
  mutate(ASV_ID = feature) %>%
  select(ASV_ID, coef, stderr, N, pval, qval, enrich, Taxa)

write_csv(overlap_table.16, 
          '16S_enriched_prevalent_overlap.csv')
```
